title: UTF-16 range assignment
summary: Recovered Game.exe 0x44f9b0 range assignment as a genuine thiscall member. Preserves inline/heap selection, unsigned interior-source detection before the size guard, delegation to self substring assignment, capacity growth with old length, count-times-two memcpy, length publication and trailing NUL. Direct original instructions and range/empty callers establish ABI. External dependencies remain explicit port bindings; no matching credit claimed.
test_description: Passed local freestanding GCC i386 executable with accepted references linked at their original VAs; all four linked reference spans checked byte-for-byte against immutable Game.exe. Differential cases enumerate capacities 0,1,7,8,15,31 and all valid lengths, null/external/base/terminator sources with zero count, base aliases with counts 0,1,2,7,8,31,0x7ffffffe,0x7fffffff,0xffffffff, and each interior position with zero count. Checks returned this, full guarded objects, untouched storage bytes, full backing arrays, length, capacity, NUL and substring-helper intermediate NUL side effects. Independent expected-value test covers nonempty external copy containing embedded zero and surrogate code units; that case is explicitly not differential. Dependency sentinels verify no growth/error paths execute.
known_limits: Nonempty external-copy oracle path needs memcpy thunk 0x8f8d66 and CRT IAT 0x92d494, absent from the supplied freestanding runtime. Only recovered C++ expected-value coverage is provided for that path.

Positive-offset aliases with positive resulting length require original erase's memmove IAT 0x92d4a4 and are not executed. Substring/truncate/erase remain accepted reference dependencies, not additional recovered scope.

Growth at 0x44fde0 needs Windows allocation and FS/SEH runtime; external over-limit counts need std::_Xlength_error IAT 0x92d168. Those original paths and allocation exceptions are not behaviorally tested. Port bindings must preserve those contracts.

Original byte-address alias detection floors odd interior addresses; misaligned pointers, corrupt objects and wrapping address ranges are not tested. Supported original object ABI is 32-bit; a 64-bit port must adapt layout deliberately.
No native MSVC compiler is available locally. Implementation uses C++11-compatible syntax and guarded thiscall declarations; test.cpp is GCC-only. No byte-matching source claim.
